thesis: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale taxes every creature each upkeep, turning a land into a sweeping economic rule that rewards decks built with few creatures and abundant mana denial.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Tabernacle became a signature card of Lands and prison strategies and one of the clearest examples of a Reserved List land whose strategic identity outgrew its original context.

playbook.role: Pair Tabernacle with Wasteland, Rishadan Port, sweepers, or token control so the upkeep tax becomes impossible to pay. Track triggers precisely; the card wins through accumulated missed development.
